user.title: Connect Hagleitner Community
user.description: Enter the Azure Service Bus queue details. The connection string is stored in Home Assistant's configuration, so protect your backups.

data_description.connection_string: The Azure Service Bus connection string from the forwarding rule. Keep it secret.
data_description.queue_name: The Service Bus queue name from the same forwarding rule.

reauth_confirm.title: Update Service Bus credentials
reauth_confirm.description: Enter replacement credentials for the configured queue.

data_description.connection_string: The Azure Service Bus connection string from the forwarding rule. Keep it secret.

reconfigure.title: Change the Service Bus queue
reconfigure.description: Connect this entry to another Azure Service Bus queue. The stored credentials are checked before the change is saved.

data_description.queue_name: The Service Bus queue name from the forwarding rule.

data_description.area_id: Optionally assign the adopted device to a Home Assistant area.

abort.reauth_entry_not_found: The configuration entry could not be found.
abort.reconfigure_not_supported: Adopted device entries cannot be reconfigured.

error_active.title: {device_name}: error active
error_active.description: {resource_name} reports an active error (resource type {resource_type_id}). Check the device for details.

connection_offline.title: {device_name}: offline
connection_offline.description: {resource_name} reports that the device is offline.

flowmeter_replacement.title: {device_name}: replace flowmeter
flowmeter_replacement.description: The flowmeter has reached its volume-based replacement threshold. Replace it and reset the flowmeter change action to clear this task.

pump_replacement.title: {device_name}: replace pump
pump_replacement.description: A time- or volume-based pump replacement threshold has been reached. Replace the pump and reset its change action to clear this task.

queue_not_found.title: Service Bus queue not found
queue_not_found.description: The configured queue is missing or its name changed. Verify the queue name in the Hagleitner forwarding rule, then reconfigure this entry to use the correct queue.

error.queue_already_configured_disabled: This queue is already added but disabled. Enable the existing entry instead of adding another.
error.invalid_connection_string: The connection string is not valid. Check it and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Service Bus rejected the credentials or they do not have permission to access this queue.
error.queue_not_found: The queue could not be found. Check the queue name and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Azure Service Bus. Check the connection and try again.
error.unknown: Could not validate the queue. Check the details and try again.
